With 79.81% of scheduler cycles having no eligible warp, all warps are stalled on L1TEX memory latency. Fix: add tl.multiple_of and tl.max_contiguous hints on the contiguous store index (x2, stride-1 in output) to emit 128-bit vectorized stores, plus autotune XBLOCK/YBLOCK and num_stages to pipeline away L1TEX latency.
